arxiv-2006-12296.title: A Pipeline for Variable Selection and False Discovery Rate Control With an Application in Labor Economics
arxiv-2006-12296.creator: Sophie-Charlotte Klose, Johannes Lederer
arxiv-2006-12296.description: Abstract We introduce tools for controlled variable selection to economists. In particular, we apply a recently introduced aggregation scheme for false discovery rate (FDR) control to German administrative data to determine the parts of the individual employment histories that are relevant for the career outcomes of women.

arxiv-2208-05595.title: Downlink Interference Analysis of UAV-based mmWave Fronthaul for Small Cell Networks
arxiv-2208-05595.creator: Mohammad Taghi Dabiri, Mazen Hasna, Senior Member, IEEE, and Walid Saad, Fellow, IEEE
arxiv-2208-05595.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Mohammad Taghi Dabiri, Mazen Hasna, Senior Member, IEEE, and Walid Saad, Fellow, IEEE. In this paper, an unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV)-based heterogeneous network is studied to solve the problem of transferring massive traffic of distributed small cells to the core network. First, a detailed three-dimensional (3D) model of the downlink channel is characterized by taking into account the real antenna pattern, UAVs’ vibrations, random distribution of small cell base stations (SBSs), and the position of UAVs in 3D space.

arxiv-2211-03955.title: Spectroscopy of chimera baryons in a 𝑺 ​ 𝒑 ​ ( 𝟒 ) Sp(4) lattice gauge theory
arxiv-2211-03955.creator: Davide Vadacchino
arxiv-2211-03955.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Davide Vadacchino. Chimera baryons are an important element of strongly coupled theories that provide a microscopic origin for UV complete composite Higgs models (CHMs), since they play the role of top partners in top partial compositeness. In a particular interesting realisation of CHMs based upon an underlying S ​ p ​ ( 4 ) Sp(4) gauge theory, such exotic objects are composed of two fermion constituents transforming on the fundamental, and one on the 2-index antisymmetric representations.

arxiv-2302-06786.title: Interference and noise cancellation for joint communication radar (JCR) system based on contextual information Thanks: This work was supported in part by the UK EPSRC under grants EP/P009670/1 and EP/T021063/1, and Petroleum Technology Development Fund (Grant number: PTDF/ED/PHD/NCO/1352/18).
arxiv-2302-06786.creator: Christantus O. Nnamani, Mathini Sellathurai
arxiv-2302-06786.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Christantus O. Nnamani, Mathini Sellathurai. This paper examines the separation of wireless communication and radar signals, thereby guaranteeing cohabitation and acting as a panacea to spectrum sensing. First, considering that the channel impulse response was known by the receivers (communication and radar), we showed that the optimizing beamforming weights mitigate the interference caused by signals and improve the physical layer security (PLS) of the system.

arxiv-2308-15159.title: artpol : Analytical ray-tracing method for spectro-polarimetric properties of accretion disks around Kerr black holes
arxiv-2308-15159.creator: Vladislav Loktev, Alexandra Veledina, Juri Poutanen, Joonas Nättilä, Valery F. Suleimanov
arxiv-2308-15159.description: Abstract Spectro-polarimetric signatures of accretion disks in X-ray binaries and active galactic nuclei contain information about the masses and spins of their central black holes, as well as the geometry of matter close to the compact objects. This information can be extracted using the means of X-ray polarimetry.

arxiv-2405-09462.title: Zeno Effect Suppression of Gauge Drift in Quantum Simulations
arxiv-2405-09462.creator: Carter Ball, Thomas D. Cohen
arxiv-2405-09462.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Carter Ball, Thomas D. Cohen. Quantum simulation of lattice gauge theories is a promising tool for the study of many complicated problems including ones with real-time dynamics. For gauge theories, however, there is a major challenge in maintaining gauge invariance during time evolution. Such theories have a full Hilbert space that is larger than the physical space—the set of states which are gauge invariant or equivalently respect the Gauss law.

arxiv-2407-13449.title: All Roads Lead to Rome? Investigating Representational Similarities in Generative Image Models
arxiv-2407-13449.creator: Charumathi Badrinath, Usha Bhalla, Alex Oesterling, Suraj Srinivas, Himabindu Lakkaraju
arxiv-2407-13449.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Charumathi Badrinath, Usha Bhalla, Alex Oesterling, Suraj Srinivas, Himabindu Lakkaraju. Do different generative image models secretly learn similar underlying representations? We investigate this by measuring the latent space similarity of four different models: VAEs, GANs, Normalizing Flows (NFs), and Diffusion Models (DMs). Our methodology involves training linear maps between frozen latent spaces to “stitch” arbitrary pairs of encoders and decoders and measuring output-based and probe-based metrics on the resulting “stitched” models.

arxiv-2410-05987.title: The Fused Model of Alternating Spin Chain from ABJM Theory
arxiv-2410-05987.creator: Nan Bai, Fan Feng, Mao-Zhong Shao
arxiv-2410-05987.description: Abstract In this paper we give an algebraic construction of the fused model for ABJM spin chain and find the corresponding boost operator. We also investigate the open spin Hamiltonian for fused model and point out the general common structures of the boundary terms.

arxiv-2412-20247.title: Well-posedness and approximation of reflected McKean-Vlasov SDEs with applications
arxiv-2412-20247.creator: P. D. Hinds, A. Sharma, M. V. Tretyakov
arxiv-2412-20247.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by P. D. Hinds, A. Sharma, M. V. Tretyakov. In this paper, we establish well-posedness of reflected McKean-Vlasov SDEs and their particle approximations in smooth non-convex domains. We prove convergence of the interacting particle system to the corresponding mean-field limit with the optimal rate of convergence. We motivate this study with applications to sampling and optimization in constrained domains by considering reflected mean-field Langevin SDEs and two reflected consensus-based optimization (CBO) models, respectively.

arxiv-2503-12898.title: A Sample of Low-mass AGNs Extended to z ≈ \approx 0.6
arxiv-2503-12898.creator: Wen-Juan Liu (刘文娟), Luis C. Ho, Xiao-Bo Dong (董小波), Su Yao (姚苏), Paulina Lira
arxiv-2503-12898.description: Abstract We present a catalog of 927 low-mass active galactic nuclei (AGNs) with black hole mass of M BH M_{\mathrm{BH}} ⩽ 2 × 10 6 \leqslant 2\times 10^{6} M ⊙ M_{\odot} characterized by broad H α \alpha or H β \beta emission lines, uniformly selected from the Seventeenth Data Release (DR17) of the Sloan Digital Sky Survey (SDSS) spectra.

arxiv-2506-06292.title: Mutual-Taught for Co-adapting Policy and Reward Models
arxiv-2506-06292.creator: Tianyuan Shi, Canbin Huang, Fanqi Wan, Longguang Zhong, Ziyi Yang, Weizhou Shen, Xiaojun Quan, Ming Yan
arxiv-2506-06292.description: Abstract During the preference optimization of large language models (LLMs), distribution shifts may arise between newly generated model samples and the data used to train the reward model (RM). This shift reduces the efficacy of the RM, which in turn negatively impacts the performance of the policy model (PM).

arxiv-2506-15313.title: MapFM: Foundation Model-Driven HD Mapping with Multi-Task Contextual Learning
arxiv-2506-15313.creator: Leonid Ivanov, Vasily Yuryev, Dmitry Yudin
arxiv-2506-15313.description: Abstract In autonomous driving, high-definition (HD) maps and semantic maps in bird’s-eye view (BEV) are essential for accurate localization, planning, and decision-making. This paper introduces an enhanced End-to-End model named MapFM for online vectorized HD map generation. We show significantly boost feature representation quality by incorporating powerful foundation model for encoding camera images.

britannica-1911-llama.title: Llama (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-llama.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-llama.description: Article 'Llama' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 16), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. the larger of the two domesticated members of the camel-tribe indigenous to South America. The llama (Lama huanacus glama) is a domesticated derivative of the wild guanaco, which has been bred as a beast of burden. Chiefly found in southern Peru, it generally attains a larger size than the guanaco, and is usually white or spotted with brown or black, and sometimes altogether black.

encyclopaedia-biblica-vol2-1901.creator: Thomas Kelly Cheyne and John Sutherland Black
encyclopaedia-biblica-vol2-1901.description: Encyclopaedia Biblica, vol. 2 (E–K, 1901) — the critical dictionary of the literary, political, religious history, archaeology, geography, and natural history of the Bible; the landmark of higher criticism.

plos-pone-0012438.title: Differences in the Cognitive Skills of Bonobos and Chimpanzees
plos-pone-0012438.creator: Esther Herrmann, Brian Hare, Josep Call et al.
plos-pone-0012438.description: PLOS ONE research article. While bonobos and chimpanzees are both genetically and behaviorally very similar, they also differ in significant ways. Bonobos are more cautious and socially tolerant while chimpanzees are more dependent on extractive foraging, which requires tools. The similarities suggest the

pmc-11508817.title: Genetic Adaptations of the Tibetan Pig to High-Altitude Hypoxia on the Qinghai–Tibet Plateau
pmc-11508817.creator: Yanan Yang, Haonan Yuan, Boyuan Yao, Shengguo Zhao, Xinrong Wang, Linna Xu, Lingyun Zhang, Brad Freking
pmc-11508817.description: The Tibetan Plateau’s distinctive high-altitude environment, marked by extreme cold and reduced oxygen levels, presents considerable survival challenges for both humans and mammals. Natural selection has led to the accumulation of adaptive mutations in Tibetan pigs, enabling them to develop distinctive adaptive phenotypes. Here, we aim to uncover the genetic mechanisms underlying the adaptation of Tibetan pigs to high-altitude hypoxia.

pmc-12392503.title: Quantitative susceptibility mapping shows alterations of brain iron content in children with autism spectrum disorder: a whole-brain analysis
pmc-12392503.creator: Xiaowen Xu, Yang Li, Haifei Lan, Ning Ding, Weikai Li, Guifen Zheng, Xiufeng Song
pmc-12392503.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundIron deficiency in subcortical structures has been reported in previous studies using manually drawn regions of interest (ROIs). However, no whole-brain iron content studies in individuals with autism spectrum disorder (ASD) have been published.

pmc-12629991.title: Collective homeostasis of condensation-prone proteins via their mRNAs
pmc-12629991.creator: Rupert Faraway, Neve Costello Heaven, Holly Digby, Klara Kuret Hodnik, Jure Rebselj, Oscar G Wilkins, Anob M Chakrabarti, Ira A Iosub, Neža Vadnjal, Rhys Dore, Lea Knez, Stefan L Ameres, Clemens Plaschka, Jernej Ule
pmc-12629991.description: The concentration of proteins containing intrinsically disordered regions must be tightly controlled to maintain cellular homeostasis1,2. However, mechanisms for collective control of these proteins, which tend to localize to membraneless condensates, are less understood than pathways mediated by membrane-bound organelles3,4.

pmc-12733762.title: Nephroprotective Effects of Quercetin–Selenium Nanoparticles Against Glycerol-Induced AKI
pmc-12733762.creator: Ahmed M. Ashour, Ali Khames, Khaled M. Alam-ElDein, Ahmed Hassan Ibrahim Faraag, Nievin Ahmed Mahran, Badriyah Aljazzaf, Rabia Alghazeer, Fatma Akmal, Marwa Ahmed Mahmoud, Mohamed H. A. Gadelmawla
pmc-12733762.description: Acute kidney injury (AKI) is defined as a quick and often reversible decline in renal performance, as shown by elevated creatinine or reduced urine volume. AKI is a common illness, particularly among hospitalized cases, and can be observed in up to 7% of hospital admissions and 30% of ICU admissions.

pmc-12738648.title: Comparison of the frailty phenotype and frailty index for identifying vulnerable companion dogs
pmc-12738648.creator: Sara Hoummady, Audrey Besegher, Sarah Jeannin, Thierry Bedossa, Yohan Stephan, Pauline M. Anton, Morgane Robles, Nancy Rebout
pmc-12738648.description: Frailty is a multidimensional syndrome of aging increasingly studied in companion dogs. Two main operational models have been developed: the frailty phenotype, based on five clinical criteria, and the frailty index, derived from the accumulation of health deficits. Despite their frequent use in human aging research, no comparative analysis of these models has been conducted in canine populations.

pmc-12948634.title: Saudi Heart Association Position Statement on Early Detection of Subclinical Atherosclerosis in Clinical Practice
pmc-12948634.creator: Waleed Alhabeeb, Abdulrahaman Almoghairi, Abdulhalim Kinsara, Abdullah T Khoja, Adel Tash, Halia AlShehri, Khalid Al Faraidy, Mohammed A Batais, Mohammed Balghith, Mostafa Alshamiri, Taher Hassan
pmc-12948634.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundAtherosclerosis is the leading underlying cause of cardiovascular disease (CVD), which remains the primary cause of mortality in Saudi Arabia. Saudi patients experience CVD events nearly a decade earlier than their Western counterparts.

pmc-13067125.title: Targeted delivery of lupeol via hyaluronic acid-modified ZIF-8 for anti-hepatic fibrosis therapy
pmc-13067125.creator: Bianbian Liao, Dongmei Qin, Rubing Hou
pmc-13067125.description: Hepatic fibrosis (HF), a common pathological consequence of chronic liver injury, is driven by the excessive proliferation and activation of hepatic stellate cells (aHSCs). Non-alcoholic steatohepatitis, the inflammatory form of metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD, formerly known as non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, NAFLD), serves as a key driver of the HF process.

pmc-13193745.title: Voice Recognition for Periodontal Probing Medical Records under Korean–English Bilingual Conditions: A Feasibility Study
pmc-13193745.creator: Young Woo Kim, Jin Hyeok Kook, Yiseul Choi, Wonse Park
pmc-13193745.description: ObjectivesThis study evaluated the feasibility of voice recognition-based electronic medical record (EMR) documentation for periodontal probing in dentistry, particularly emphasizing Korean-English bilingual speech patterns and real-world clinical conditions.MethodsExperiments were conducted in a dental chair setting during routine clinical hours. Environmental noise levels were measured, and two microphone types (stationary and pin-type) were evaluated.

pmc-13322761.title: Urinary indoxyl sulfate in children: age-related decline and its association with Bacteroidota in the gut microbiota
pmc-13322761.creator: Yuko AKAGAWA, Shohei AKAGAWA, Shoji TSUJI, Tomoki KITAWAKI, Ayaka ITO, Mamoru NAKANISHI, Takahiko OKADA, Sohsaku YAMANOUCHI, Kazunari KANEKO
pmc-13322761.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Urinary indoxyl sulfate (IS), a gut microbiota-derived uremic toxin, is associated with the adult gut microbiota and is elevated in children with autism spectrum disorder. However, its age-related trajectory and association with microbiota in healthy children remain uncharacterized. Therefore, we aimed to elucidate age-related changes in urinary IS in healthy children and to investigate the potential utility of urinary IS as a surrogate marker for their gut microbiota.

pmc-13397358.title: Isoliquiritigenin Suppresses Oral Squamous Cell Carcinoma Progression by Targeting FABP5-Mediated Lipid Metabolism: Association with the circPOLB/miR-548ae-3p/C-MYC Axis
pmc-13397358.creator: Liang Li, Hong Deng, Zhiyong Li, Yu Li, Lingrui Liu, Lan Xie, Yue Chen
pmc-13397358.description: Objectives: Oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC) is a common and deadly cancer affecting the oral cavity. This study aims to explore the regulatory role and molecular mechanism of miR-548ae-3p in OSCC proliferation, invasion, and lipid metabolism, as well as the therapeutic potential of isoliquiritigenin (ISL) targeting OSCC lipid metabolism.

pmc-13451278.title: A staged vision-force collaborative framework for precision robotic insertion of metallic valve components
pmc-13451278.creator: Teng Wu, Dong Zhang, Bin Liu, Huan Wu, Lingen Ren
pmc-13451278.description: Precision robotic insertion of metallic valve components remains challenging because specular reflection, depth loss, and partial occlusion degrade visual localization near the hole entrance, while contact further reduces the reliability of vision. The resulting residual pose errors often cause impact, side loading, jamming, and insertion failure.

uslaw-usc-t15-s1530.title: 15 U.S.C. § 1530 — Awarding of contracts for performance of commercial activity by National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration
uslaw-usc-t15-s1530.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t15-s1530.description: United States Code, Title 15 (Commerce And Trade); Chapter 40 (Department Of Commerce). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Administration may not award any contract for the performance of any “commercial activity”, as defined by paragraph 6.a. of the Office of Management and Budget Circular Memorandum A–76, which is performed by Administration employees until at least 30 calendar days after the Administrator.
